correctness.rationale: Direct arch-factorization establishes shortest absent length; a bijection between ordered pairs of absent targets and arch-local one-letter consumptions yields a complete three-state transfer valid for every binary source. Matrix inversion gives the full bivariate second moment. Positive aperiodic transfer matrices imply unique simple dominant positive poles; distinct root estimates force exponentially increasing relative variance. Reproducibility checker exhaustively compares both moments over all binary words to length 14 and verifies independent pair transitions and arithmetic example.

value.rationale: The complete conditional second moment gives a natural family of exact fixed-composition variances for an algorithmic reconstruction statistic, while uniform-source asymptotics prove an unexpected nonconcentration law with exponentially increasing coefficient of variation. Neither fact follows from first-moment formulas, extremal counts or algorithms for individual strings; meaningful all-length structural and probabilistic information is obtained.
